submission_authority: No request may be transmitted without user authorization. LARMAC additionally requires member or duly appointed representative authority.
request_principles: Seek existing records, indexes, reports, exports, and native electronic files; do not require creation of a new record.
Ask for rolling production and a fee estimate before chargeable work.
If responsive records were migrated, ask for legacy system names, identifiers, crosswalks, and the responsible current custodian.
If records were destroyed or transferred, ask for the applicable retention schedule, destruction authorization, transfer accession, and date.
If part of a record is exempt, request reasonably segregable non-exempt portions and an index describing withheld material.
Preserve every acknowledgement, clarification, production, fee notice, extension, no-record result, denial, referral, and closed status as evidence.
